title: 0.3.0: Transaction withRepository does not contain custom methods
body:

## Issue Description

I had defined a custom function through extending:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50786287/158995515-f888712d-2f52-4274-9158-486b780dbd3b.png)

But I cannot use it in transactions, I think this wasn't intended

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50786287/158995321-e5e9af1d-cd19-4ca1-8aec-0f6191cc4acc.png)

The code seems like it just calls the original constructor which is probably why, I'm not quite sure if there's a good way to fix this

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50786287/158995859-36dd27a9-51d8-4d3c-b086-b1fd2f79416a.png)

### Expected Behavior

Transactional entity manager should have access to custom extended functions

<!--
  A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-->


### Actual Behavior

Transactional entity manager only has access to builtin functions
